proves.claim: A census prints, per host, the minutes its slots sat idle while jobs were still queued.

cli.io-test-census-idle-slots.a-recorded.why: Without it, a slow census cannot be told from runner slots that sat idle.

proves.claim: A census whose rows ran on no host prints no idle line.

cli.io-test-census-idle-slots.a-census-w.why: Without it, a census with no runner would print a made-up host.
